mechanism: Rebuild current-TF OHLC bars from a finer basic TF (e.g. H1 from M1) with opening times shifted by k basic periods. Modes: static shift SS (fixed offset 0..Tcur/Tbase-1), DSO (dynamic shift so rightmost bar just opened), DSC (dynamic shift so rightmost bar is about to close). Patterns that are invisible on broker session-aligned bars can appear under mid-range shifts.
data_needed: MqlRates from basic TF via CopyRates; GetRatesLC(start,len,rates,base_period,shift) aggregating open/high/low/close over [tO,tC] windows; TimeCurrent for dynamic shift.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY; chart TF H1 with BaseTF M1 (also M15 examples); test window 2014.04.01–2014.10.25; MetaQuotes-Demo.
why_new_for_mis: Treats bar open/close boundary (session/timezone phase) as an explicit sensing axis: the same ticks yield different candlestick/pattern geometry under controlled shifts, exposing broker-alignment dependence of pattern sensors.
quote: Its form was changing in a smooth and flowing manner revealing hidden patterns that the initial pattern did not even have a hint on.

mechanism: On each new basic-TF bar, recompute shift so the forming higher-TF bar is either at its open (DSO, shift=-1) or near expected close (DSC, shift=-2). Pattern detectors (pin bar, MA cross) fire against this continuously re-phased bar stream, increasing entry-point density vs fixed broker bars.
data_needed: Live basic-TF ticks/bars; dynamic shift = floor((TimeCurrent-r0.time)/PeriodSeconds(base)) or 1+that mod k.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDJPY H1 rebuilt from M1; pin-bar and Moving Average EAs.

mechanism: Walk the Depth of Market from best ask (or bid), consuming level volumes until the desired size is filled; compute volume-weighted average fill vs best quote; define slippage as that gap and liquidity as capacity to fill near best price. Market buys/sells 'swallow' resting liquidity and move Last.
data_needed: Level-2 DOM (price, aggregated volume per level); intended order size; Ask/Bid/Last tick stream.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Moscow Exchange derivatives examples GOLD-9.14, silver, Si-12.14; tick/DOM real-time (not bar TF).
why_new_for_mis: Operationalizes liquidity as pre-trade VWAP-vs-best and post-trade DOM depletion—usable as a continuous liquidity stress sensor, not just spread.
quote: Liquidity is the ability of market participants to buy from you and sell to you the amount of goods you are interested in, at prices close to the market one.

mechanism: Exchange sets daily upper/lower price limits; hitting a limit pauses order acceptance, redistributes risks, then resets limits from the new price. On charts, limit hits appear as bars with Open=High=Low=Close; multiple limits can fire in one session under extreme volatility.
data_needed: Per-instrument upper/lower limit levels (exchange site or MT5 SymbolInfo); last-deal price; session calendar.

mechanism: Encode each bar as DIRECTION_UP/DOWN/NONE from sign(Close-Open). Naive sensors: next direction = prior (persist) or −prior (reverse). Adaptive sensor: keep current rule until a forecast error, then flip persist↔reverse. Tested as one-bar-ahead direction forecast.
